 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Nadi Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Nadi Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Nadi Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Libra Shani Horoscope Today, 29 October 2026: Venus rises on your lagna this Karwa Chauth, confidence and glow return 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 29, 2026, 04:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Libra starts to feel like itself again this Thursday. Venus, your ruling planet, has moved clear of the Sun’s glare on your lagna, though it stays retrograde until mid-November. After a month of low energy and self-doubt, confidence begins to return in small, noticeable ways. Karwa Chauth also falls during this period, a festival of devotion that suits Venus’s themes of love and grace. The Moon moves from Taurus, your eighth, into Gemini, your ninth, by afternoon. Venus Rises on Your Lagna
 With your ruler visible again, you may notice others responding more warmly. Clothes you set aside may feel right again, and conversations flow more easily. This glow builds slowly. Venus still moves backwards, so let it grow rather than forcing it. Karwa Chauth and Libra
 Married Libra women keeping the vrat may find the fast easier than expected, with energy steady through the day. Husbands can join in spirit by fasting lightly or preparing the evening meal. Dress in red or pink for the evening puja, as both colours suit a reviving Venus. Moon Moves into the Ninth
 After a sensitive morning in your eighth, the Moon enters Gemini, your ninth, in Mrigashira. Faith and optimism rise towards evening, just in time for moonrise. The debilitated Sun and retrograde Mercury in your lagna still call for humility in speech. Shani and Jupiter
 Retrograde Shani, your yogakaraka, in the sixth keeps health habits disciplined, which supports a gentle fast. Exalted Jupiter in your tenth blesses your reputation. Do’s for Today
 Dress in red or pink for the evening puja.
 Let confidence grow without forcing it.
 Don’ts for Today
 Avoid overexerting during the fast.
 Do not speak proudly while the Sun is weak.
 Shani Remedy for Today
 Gift a new dupatta to a woman who cannot afford one for the festival. Serve sweet yellow rice to children outside a temple on Thursday.
